name: tm-dashboard
description: Live task board for .bytedesk/task-management. HTTP + SSE, tails events.jsonl. The port is assigned once — probed free above 45000, then kept, so the project opens at the same URL every time — and written to .bytedesk/task-management/dashboard.port (TM_DASHBOARD_PORT to pin one). Runs while the plugin is enabled.

name: tm-pool
description: Makes sure .bytedesk/task-management has its pickup loop, without becoming one: `tm pool ensure` starts ONE detached pool per repository if none is live, then exits. That pool collects finished dispatched workers each tick, then dispatches ready-for-agent tasks that pass the readiness check up to dispatch.poolWip (default 3), preferring touches-disjoint sets. It outlives every session, so a second session costs nothing, and it exits after dispatch.idleExitMinutes with nothing to do. Config is re-read every poll, so `tm config dispatch.enabled false` stops it within one poll. Its stream is pool.log. Explicit control is `tm pool once|start|stop|status|resume`.
